semiconductor_relevance: High — Nitto Denko India Pvt Ltd specializes in semiconductor tapes and solutions that are critical for various manufacturing processes in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Nitto Denko India Pvt Ltd is a leading provider of advanced semiconductor tapes designed for backgrinding, dicing, die attach film (DAF), and lead frame taping. Their innovative solutions enhance process efficiency and device integrity in high-precision semiconductor manufacturing.

regional_presence.India: Nitto Denko has a strategic presence in India, focusing on providing tailored solutions for the semiconductor market.
